slides.texte_overlay:
Habits that make people
instantly comfortable around you
Greeting people like you're happy to see them. A real smile, their name, a warm "Good to see you." Most people decide within seconds if they can relax around you.
Speaking at a calm, easy pace. Rushing makes others feel rushed. A relaxed voice tells everyone around you that there's no pressure here.
Letting people finish their stories. No jumping in with your own, no correcting details. Being heard all the way through, without interruption, makes people feel safe and respected.
Sharing small things about yourself. A funny detail from your day, a little worry, a favourite song. A little openness from you invites people to open up in return.
Always having a light topic ready. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a fun fact is the easiest way to make a stranger smile and relax.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A fun fact is the easiest way to make a stranger relax.

slides.texte_overlay: Never making fun of people who aren't there. If you joke about others, people wonder what you say about them. Kindness behind backs builds trust.
Being the same in every mood. Not friendly one day and cold the next. Steady warmth is what makes people feel comfortable around you for good.
